For a PVM E on a measurable space define mu_rho(B)=tr(rho E(B)). This equals sum_n w_n(E(B)u_n,u_n)=sum_n w_n||E(B)u_n||^2. Justification: multiply the trace-norm spectral expansion by the bounded projection and use trace continuity. Every term is nonnegative; total mass is 1; countable additivity follows by nonnegative double-series interchange and strong additivity of E. Hence mu_rho is a probability measure, without a physical interpretation being presumed.
